Introduction

SKOSHISM is a South Korean virtual boy band affiliated with Hubble Office. The band consists of five members who were revealed at different intervals: Nino, Koyo, Oto, Iro, and Robo. The group uses motion capture technology to perform their band activities. They debuted on July 27, 2025, with their first mini album and second original song, Mirai Line. The group's first original song, Flying, was not released on music platforms until September 10, 2025, as the second single.
